objective: Reduce repeated evaluator dispatch call and argument-transfer overhead without changing checking or memoization semantics.
evidence: Full-input profiles 45717337815 and 45718077915 agree exactly on all 315 active checker-named symbol totals. eval_node accounts for 72,352,108,974 instructions. Its entry block executes 948,654,362 times, with a common eight-instruction return block at the same frequency. Inlining may reduce some overhead but does not guarantee removal of all spills or a speedup.
mechanism: Add inline(always) to eval_node only. No cache key, lookup, traversal, binding, universe, declaration, decision or resource limit changes.
cost_gate: Two alternating matched generic-build pairs must ACCEPT the exact 25,131-declaration prefix and each use at least 1% fewer calibrated software-counted instructions.
if_gate_fails: Retain source, build identity and raw observations; reject performance promotion without broad qualification.
if_gate_passes: Require the unchanged 230 portable outcomes and source controls, then exact full Mathlib native/instruction comparison. Increased code size may affect native CPU differently from instruction counts.
lineage: Compact single-binding IDs and depth-gated right-spine memoization both failed their predeclared prefix gates; preserved separately.
boundary: Original compiler-hint experiment against the attributed core. Candidate only, not an Arena score or release.
full_gate: Two alternating native pairs and two alternating software-instruction pairs on exact full Mathlib. Every process must ACCEPT 739167 declarations. Each instruction pair ratio <=0.99; native median CPU ratio <=1.05; maximum observed RSS ratio <=1.10. Frozen executables copied before Cargo tests. Other nine large inputs and official Arena scoring remain separate obligations.
